metadata.source_citation: Leah Brooks and Byron Lutz (2019), Vestiges of Transit: Urban Persistence at a Microscale, Review of Economics and Statistics 101(3), 385-399. GIS digitization credited to Jordan Hale in the paper.
metadata.method: Split original geometry against flat-ended buffers around parallel segments in the other period. Classified source observations retained but hidden. Three display features dissolve exact duplicates within each class; shared display uses 1928 geometry. No snapping or historical date inference.
metadata.limitations: Near-parallel tracks within five metres can match. Larger digitizing offsets may appear period-only. The 1915 PE source covers a smaller area than 1928. Period-only means present only in that source, not evidence of opening or abandonment dates. Neither source establishes full regional or all-time coverage.
